create_BimanualViperXTask: create a BimanualViperXTask instance for simulated bi-manual robot manipulation with joint position control
create_TransferCubeTask: create a TransferCubeTask instance that rewards transferring a red box from right gripper to left gripper
create_InsertionTask: create an InsertionTask instance that rewards inserting a red peg into a socket with a pin
build_get_observation: build an observation dict with qpos, qvel, env_state, and top/angle/vis images from a dm_control physics object
run_get_reward: run the reward function to evaluate task progress based on contact pairs between grippers and objects
